response.overview: Mi-ae returns to the motel room where she once built a “heart bomb” with her ex-lover, Gyeom a reckless promise to detonate it the moment their love ended. Searching for the device, she clings to memories she refuses to bury. When Gyeom unexpectedly appears, the two confront the truth behind their breakup, and the room transforms into a battlefield between desire and escape. Red threads binding them blur reality and illusion as the timer begins to count down. A visceral story about a love too violent to hold, and too real to release.
response.title: AFTER LOVE BOMB
